touches.text: Install and upgrades live here: the installer machine walks the host-seam intentions, verifies each, offers what's missing, applies, re-verifies. If xyz library needs an update, this is the component that does it. Any change to what the host is goes through here (6.6.3.1.1).
Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed.
intentions_model_compiler: copies every intention into intentions-congruency-lab/. WHY: so that one folder can regrow the system on a bare machine. USERS: Cairn (cairn compile).
operator_inbox: builds the operator's to-do list from live state, storing nothing (7.3.7). USERS: Operator.
ticket_inspector: completeness checks over tickets at rest. [why?] USERS: CodeMother.

dataref: one address for any stored record, in any format, and the thin class that reads it. Shaped by Akien and CC 2026-11-09, grown from CC0AC-Weather 1.4.8's secrets.env. WHY: a config, a ticket or a node can say WHERE a value lives without carrying it, so the repo stays shareable and a private value stays in ~/.cairn; and one way of pointing works across every format and every box. USERS: anything that reads stored data.

cairn:/// is the repo (from the environment, or from where bin/cairn itself lives); cairncommons:/// is the commons repo beside it; instance:/// is ~/.cairn; claude:/// is ~/.claude (the project's own .claude/ is already cairn:///.claude/, so it gets no second name); db:///cairn/table/row is the database; file:/// keeps its usual meaning, a real path on the filesystem, for what no root holds. claude: is also the Claude app's link scheme on this box: the resolver never hands an address to the system, so only a click on one opens the app.
